metadata.name: sheetsync.commit
metadata.description: (state, seg, key, source) -> {ok, hash, layers}. The CRDT change pipeline (Phase 3): gate the author (writableBy), diff the segment SOURCE string before->after the edit, crdt.layer + keystore.sign, verify the signature + re-gate the signer, crdt.append to <seg>.crdt, fold the stack -> source cels (setCel) + runCycle (derived recompute locally), then stamp <seg>.hash. SOURCES only; one writer at a time; non-writers dropped. Loopback now; Phase 4 puts the op on a WebRTC channel.
